Meta.title: Candid Bureau — weddings and short-form content
Meta.description: We film weddings without posing or direction, and turn them into a film and content made for social media.

Hero.intro: Weddings filmed without posing or direction — cut both for the big screen and for the one in your hand.

About.title: We don't direct the day. We just don't miss it.
About.body: [Short text about her — how she works, how long, why weddings. Two or three sentences, in her own words.]

film.name: Wedding film
film.description: The full film of the day, 8–15 minutes. The whole arc, without rushing past what mattered.

reels.name: Reels for social
reels.description: Three to five vertical cuts, edited for Instagram and TikTok. Ready to post.

teaser.name: Next-day teaser
teaser.description: One minute, in your inbox the day after — while everyone is still in it.

Contact.body: Send us the date and the location — we reply within two days.

ContactPage.metaDescription: Check whether your date is still open. Send us the date and location of your wedding.
ContactPage.title: Tell us the date and where it all happens.
ContactPage.intro: The earlier you write, the better the odds your date is open — summer weekends go first.
ContactPage.responseTime: We reply within two working days. If you don't hear back, check your spam folder — it happens.
